annotations.text:
Both artboards carry a Sunset toggle.

Off = the normal state (sea blue, 46 min left).
On = shkia approaching — the rule, the time and the countdown all warm to coral, 8 min left.

That is the signature behaviour: the colour tells you your window is closing.
הרמב״ם is the honest row. The source data says only "בזמן" — the offset was never published — so it shows as unknown with a prompt to correct it, never as a guessed time.
